summary: Completed comprehensive testing of three NEW Nomadly Bot features: 1) Plan downgrade auto-disable features, 2) IVR Analytics collection and reporting, 3) Custom voicemail greeting via audio upload. All features are properly implemented with full functionality.

minor_issues.issue: Webhook endpoint returns 404 instead of expected 405 method not allowed
minor_issues.impact: Minor - does not affect new feature functionality

passed_tests: Health endpoint operational - Node.js bot running, database connected
FEATURE 1 - Plan Downgrade Auto-Disable: cpChangePlan handler implemented with complete auto-disable logic
Plan downgrade from Business→Pro/Starter automatically disables IVR when canAccessFeature(newPlan, 'ivr') is false
Plan downgrade auto-disables call recording when canAccessFeature(newPlan, 'callRecording') is false
Plan downgrade to Starter auto-disables voicemail when canAccessFeature(newPlan, 'voicemail') is false
Plan downgrade to Starter auto-disables SMS email/webhook when canAccessFeature(newPlan, 'smsToEmail') is false
Downgrade notification message properly lists all disabled features in confirmMsg
FEATURE 2 - IVR Analytics: ivrAnalytics MongoDB collection created and initialized
trackIvrAnalytics function in voice-service.js stores digit, action, callerFrom, phoneNumber, timestamp
getIvrAnalytics function returns totalCalls, optionBreakdown with digit/count/percent, topOption, recentCalls
IVR Analytics button (📊 IVR Analytics) present in IVR menu keyboards
ivrAnalyticsReport function in phone-config.js generates formatted report with bar chart visualization
IVR analytics tracking called from handleGatherEnded when DTMF digits received
FEATURE 3 - Custom Voicemail: vmCustomGreeting button exists in phone-config
cpVmGreeting, cpVmAudioUpload, cpVmTextGreeting action states defined in _index.js
Voice/audio message handler in _index.js handles msg.voice/msg.audio for cpVmAudioUpload state
Handler extracts fileId, gets file link, sets customAudioGreetingUrl, updates phone number features
Voice service plays custom audio via Telnyx playback_start API when customAudioGreetingUrl is set
Voice service handles call.playback.ended event for custom audio greeting continuation
Voicemail menu shows '🔊 Greeting' button when voicemail enabled
Voicemail menu displays greeting type (Custom Audio/Custom Text/Default) in status text
